newsitem.title: GABON: Gabon local poll scrapped for Libreville district.
newsitem.headline: Gabon local poll scrapped for Libreville district.

text.p: Gabon said on Wednesday chaotic local elections on October 20 had been scrapped for the Libreville district accounting for more than half the ballot.

The National Elections Commission which ordered the cancellation also said the ruling Democratic Party of President Omar Bongo and the opposition Woodcutters' Party won most of seats in other areas. Detailed results were not available.

About 1,900 city hall seats were on offer nationwide in the elections marred by poor organisation. Angry voters smashed polling booths and held an official hostage in Port Gentil, the commercial hub of the oil-producing Central African nation.
No date has been announced for a rerun of the vote in Libreville, but the cancellation looked certain to lead to a postponement of parliamentary elections set for November 17.
